preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of queries m is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 0 <= d_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= x_i <= 10**9 for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query has v_i between 1 and n inclusive, d_i between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive, and x_i between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in result)
postconditions.description: Each value in the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= value <= 3 * 10**5 * 10**9 for value in result)
postconditions.description: Each value in the output is between 0 and 300,000,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == sum(x_i for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries if d(v_i, i) <= d_i)
postconditions.description: The value in the i-th vertex is the sum of x_i for all queries where the distance from v_i to i is less than or equal to d_i.
